name: Ossa Quill
seed: To prevent another route catastrophe by keeping the right to decide who may reconnect anything.
design: Snowy owl, pale barred feathers, midnight-blue mantle, copper archival seals and one frost-darkened wing tip.
history: An archivist raised by a parent born just after the Severance. Inherited the stories of genuine protective closures and later extended authority through altered records.
desire: To prevent another route catastrophe by keeping the right to decide who may reconnect anything.
contradiction: A necessary historical sacrifice becomes justification for permanent control.
relationships: Ysolde is her student; Namu has independent records; Veyra sometimes benefits from closed routes but did not create the order.
arc: Evidence forces her to distinguish a real dangerous coupling from a fabricated prohibition. She must surrender exclusive judgment or become the danger she fears.
story_engine: A villain tells the truth about a hazard; the heroes need a technical procedure from someone they must also hold accountable.
writer_truth: She forged one modern closure order; she did not cause the original Severance 92 years ago.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
